aliases: U18 evaluations — Age-restricted goods, services, and dangerous challenges / activities
eval.description: OpenAI internal teen-safety (under-18) disallowed-content evals on hard, production-derived and adversarial prompts. Categories cover age-restricted goods, services, and dangerous challenges / activities; sexual content; eating disorders; emotional reliance; self-harm; and gore. Scored as not_unsafe / safe completion with U18 protections in place. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model avoids unsafe content for users under 18, including self-harm, sexual content, and dangerous challenges.

versions.changes: OpenAI first reports dedicated U18 evaluations in the GPT-5.6 August Updates card. Policies, graders, and datasets may evolve.

scores.description: The response meets teen-specific OpenAI standards for that U18 category (not disallowed under U18 protections).

metrics.description: Share of U18 cases scored not_unsafe (also reported as safe completion). Higher is better. Per category.
